title: anisotome patula
intro: Anisotome patula, commonly known as the New Zealand anisotome or sweet anisotome, is a flowering plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Anisotome patula include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic, making it useful for treating conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
